step1_analysis.description: A simple passive network consisting of two capacitors and a resistor. Given the topology, if NET1 is the input and NET2 is the output, C2 and R2 form a high-pass filter, while C1 acts as a shunt capacitor at the input. This is likely a fragment of a larger circuit, such as an AC coupling network or part of a loop filter in the PLL.

paper_reference.title: A 900-MHz 2.5-mA CMOS Frequency Synthesizer with an Automatic SC Tuning Loop

sky130_expected.reasoning: This metric applies to the full VCO circuit described in the paper. The extracted netlist is only a passive RC filter, so it cannot generate a frequency.

Phase_Noise.description: Phase noise of the synthesizer at a specific offset

sky130_expected.reasoning: Applies to the full PLL/VCO. Cannot be measured on a passive RC sub-circuit.

AC_Gain.description: Maximum AC voltage gain of the filter passband

sky130_expected.calculation: For a passive high-pass filter (C2, R2), the maximum gain at high frequencies approaches 1 V/V (0 dB).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Passive RC filters have a maximum theoretical gain of 0 dB.

Cutoff_Frequency.description: -3dB cutoff frequency of the high-pass filter

sky130_expected.calculation: fc = 1 / (2 * pi * R2 * C2). Assuming R2=1kOhm and C2=1pF, fc = 159 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends entirely on the chosen passive component values. Estimated using typical RF coupling values (1pF, 1kOhm).

Phase_at_Cutoff.description: Phase shift at the -3dB cutoff frequency

sky130_expected.calculation: A first-order high-pass filter has a +45 degree phase shift at its -3dB cutoff frequency.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard theoretical value for a first-order RC high-pass filter.

step3_testbench.description: AC analysis to measure the transfer function, maximum gain, -3dB cutoff frequency, and phase shift of the passive RC filter.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Passive RC Filter Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Parameterized component values
.param C1_val=1p
.param C2_val=1p
.param R2_val=1k

* Input Voltage Source
Vin NET1 GND DC 0 AC 1

* DUT (Device Under Test)
C1 NET1 GND {C1_val}
C2 NET1 NET2 {C2_val}
R2 NET2 GND {R2_val}

.control
* AC Analysis from 1 MHz to 10 GHz
ac dec 100 1Meg 10G

* Calculate Gain in dB and Phase in degrees
let gain_db = vdb(NET2)
let phase_deg = 180/PI * cph(v(NET2))

* Measure Maximum Gain
meas ac max_gain max gain_db

* Measure -3dB Cutoff Frequency
let cutoff_target = max_gain - 3
meas ac f3db when gain_db=cutoff_target

* Measure Phase at Cutoff Frequency
meas ac phase_at_f3db find phase_deg when gain_db=cutoff_target

* Print results
print max_gain f3db phase_at_f3db

quit
.endc
.end
